name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A small trend line for stat cards and table cells, decorative unless you name it.

examples.name: sparkline-demo
examples.title: In a stat card
examples.description: An area sparkline under a figure, named for screen readers.

examples.name: sparkline-line
examples.title: Line variant
examples.description: Palette slots, a linear curve and a gap for a missing value.

props.name: data
props.description: Values, oldest first. null leaves a gap. Needs at least two values to draw.

props.name: variant
props.description: area adds a gradient fill (24% → 0%) under the line.

props.name: curve
props.description: smooth is monotone cubic and never overshoots.

props.name: showEndDot
props.description: A dot on the latest value with a 2px ring in the surface colour.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour by meaning. Use success/danger only when the direction is good or bad news.

props.name: series
props.description: Colour by chart palette slot, to match a series in a nearby chart. Wins over tone.

props.name: yDomain
props.description: Fixes the y range; by default the line fills the height.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Makes it role="img" with this name. Without it the sparkline is aria-hidden.

notes: Decorative (aria-hidden) by default: the figure and delta beside it carry the meaning.
With aria-label it becomes role="img"; describe the trend in words ("Up 18% over 12 months"), not the raw values.
Not focusable and not interactive. For values a reader must inspect, use AreaChart.
It mirrors in right-to-left locales, like the time axis.
Draw-in and the end-dot pop sit behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

do: Put the number that matters next to it as text.
Size it with CSS (inline-size, block-size); it redraws at its real pixel size.
Set --_ring when it sits on a surface other than surface.raised.
dont: Don't use a sparkline as the only evidence of a trend.
Don't use success/danger tones for series that aren't good or bad news.
